No additional spoken dialogue. No audible background conversations. Natural accurate lip synchronization. No subtitles. No captions. No text. No watermark. No logo. === GLOBAL ACTION === Some time has passed since the battlefield conversation in Scene 9. Riven is training alone in the military camp. Ally Soldier notices her and watches for a short time. He is impressed by how controlled and effortless her swordsmanship appears. He approaches Riven because he genuinely wants to understand how she became so skilled. Their interaction remains casual. Riven does not immediately become a formal teacher. She simply realizes what Ally Soldier wants and gives him an opportunity to try. Do not begin with Riven standing still. She moves through a short sequence of controlled sword practice. Her movements are strong, efficient, and experienced. The large sword has believable weight. Riven uses her whole body naturally to control it. Her footwork is stable. Her movements flow smoothly from one position into another. Do not choreograph every individual sword strike. Allow the training movement to feel natural and cinematic. Do not make Riven perform impossible acrobatics. No spinning for spectacle. No supernatural movement. No magical effects. No glowing sword. Nearby, Ally Soldier enters the edge of the training yard. He is not interrupting immediately. He slows down when he notices Riven practicing. Ally Soldier watches her for a short moment. He shifts his weight naturally and rests one hand casually near his own weapon or belt. His eyes follow Riven's movement. He is studying what she is doing rather than simply staring at her. Riven finishes the short training sequence with one controlled final movement. She lowers the sword naturally. She exhales. She adjusts her grip and briefly rolls one shoulder after the physical effort. Ally Soldier approaches. Riven notices him coming. She gives him a brief glance. She is already familiar and comfortable with him after Scene 9. Ally Soldier stops a natural conversational distance away. He looks at Riven's large sword, then back at her. Ally Soldier: "How do you do that?" Riven looks at him. She does not immediately understand what he means. Riven: "Do what?" Ally Soldier makes a small gesture toward Riven's sword and the training space she was just using. Ally Soldier: "Make it look easy." Riven glances briefly at her sword. Then she looks back at Ally Soldier. Her response is simple and matter-of-fact. Riven: "It isn't." Ally Soldier gives a small amused reaction. He looks toward the training yard, then back toward Riven. His expression becomes slightly more serious. It is clear that he genuinely wants to learn. Allow a short pause. Riven studies him for a moment. She understands why he came over. She does not give him a speech. She does not formally announce that she will train him. Instead, Riven calmly turns toward the open training space. She makes a small gesture for Ally Soldier to come forward. Riven: "Show me what you've got." Ally Soldier realizes she is giving him a chance. A small confident smile appears. He steps into the training space. He draws or prepares his training weapon naturally. Riven moves several steps away and turns to face him. She brings her large sword into a relaxed ready position. Ally Soldier adjusts his stance. His first stance is competent but clearly less refined than Riven's. Riven immediately notices the weaknesses in his posture. She subtly studies his feet, grip, and balance. Do not begin a full fight. Do not begin an extended sparring sequence. Hold briefly on the two of them facing each other across the training yard. Riven is calm and experienced. Ally Soldier is focused and eager to prove himself. Around them, the military camp continues functioning naturally. Other soldiers train in the distance. Banners move in the mountain wind. Riven gives Ally Soldier a small challenging look. Ally Soldier tightens his grip and prepares himself. CUT. === END STATE FOR CONTINUITY === Riven and Ally Soldier are now standing opposite each other in the military training yard. Ally Soldier has directly shown that he wants to learn from Riven. Riven has agreed to give him a chance without making the moment overly formal. They have NOT completed a sparring match yet. Neither character is injured. Riven's large sword remains intact. Ally Soldier is ready to train. Riven is ready to test him. The scene completes its own narrative action: Ally Soldier approaches Riven because he wants to learn from her. Riven accepts. Their actual training relationship can now develop naturally in Scene 11. === MOOD === Relaxed. Grounded. Slightly playful. Natural military-camp atmosphere. This is not an emotional scene. This is not romance. This is not hero worship. Ally Soldier respects Riven's skill and genuinely wants to improve. Riven is beginning to accept him as someone worth teaching. Their friendship from Scene 9 is slowly developing into a mentor-and-younger-brother dynamic. The scene should end with anticipation for their first real training session.、16:9
